messages:
harper: FYI opened a tiny docs PR to clarify how our "normalized units" map to pricing tiers and to update SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120. Main goals: show a compact formula for converting tokens -> normalized_units, replace any remaining `x-rw-usage` samples, and fix the console permalink on the pricing page.

toni: Nice. Could we add a short recommended check before sending big batches: query the quota pulse and inspect top-level `consumption_summary` rather than raw headers? Many users are copying header parsing that breaks with tier arrays.

arjun: Agreed. Suggest snippet that reads `consumption_summary.normalized_remaining` and falls back to per-tier scanning. Also call out per-tenant API keys required for the quota endpoint.

harper: Added a 3-line python example that demonstrates the fallback. Kept the price math as variables (cost_per_norm_unit) and added a one-line example comment showing how to compute cost for 25k tokens.

```python
# sample: prefer summary, else scan tiers
resp = requests.get(qp_url, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}"})
summary = resp.json().get("consumption_summary")
remaining = summary.get("normalized_remaining") if summary else sum(t["remaining"] for t in resp.json().get("tiers", []))
```

toni: Looks good. One request: don't hardcode the endpoint in docs text, use a variable like `{quota_endpoint}` and include a note that some self-hosted installs expose a different path.

arjun: Also flag eventual consistency: quota pulses can lag up to ~90s in edge cases after plan changes. Add a short troubleshooting bullet.

harper: Done for both. I also swapped the console link to a permalink and included the panel UID in parentheses. Left a TODO to ask eng-infra to standardize permalinks across prod regions.

ben: tiny nit: legal asked we not publish exact numeric thresholds for tier upgrades. Keep formulas and link to pricing matrix. Otherwise LGTM.

docs-bot: PR opened by harper: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120  reviewers requested: toni, arjun. Checks queued: linkcheck, snippet-lint.

toni: Approved after minor wording tweak.

arjun: Engineering verified the example parsing and confirmed header rename to `x-rw-consumption` in SDKs. Approved.

harper: Merged after CI green. Follow-up: posted short note in #release-notes and filed INFRA-901 to track permalink standardization for hosted vs private installs. Closing thread.
